t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnomes that appear are in set groups; 1 or the other leads to a bright forest with a red basket, or a darker forest with a yellow basket. The gnome's hat or size are irrelavent in determining the number of mushrooms. what's important is the forest, and which one is in good harvest.

vb_textbox.text: Hello.The game is simple but requires your focus and concentration to max points (to gain high bonus).There are 4 sets of gnomes that rotate throughout the experiment. The key here is to familiarise yourself with the options presented in each set; These are: Orange & Brown Green & Pink Red & Yellow Blue & PurpleChoosing Orange, Green, Red and Blue will take you to a Bright Forest.Choosing Brown, Pink, Yellow and Purple will take you to a Darker Forest.To some extent it is trial and error, but if you find you receive a high number of Mushrooms in one forest, you know to select the gnome which will help you return there. If you get nothing in your basket, quickly switch to the other forest! Remember be quick in choosing using 's' or 'k' and make sure you press spacebar promptly when in the forest. Follow these instructions and you will find a successful rhythm in gathering lots of mushrooms (points which equate to £).Good luck.
